title: RadDiff: Describing Differences in Radiology Image Sets with Natural Language

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing a race-predictive Vision Transformer by applying the RadDiff system to compare high-confidence subsets of chest radiographs from different racial groups (White vs. Asian, White vs. Black). The system generates natural language descriptions of the distinguishing features to uncover non-biological confounders, acquisition-related factors, and underdiagnosis bias.

Using the RadDiff framework to comparatively analyze chest radiographs of older (> 60 years) versus younger (≤ 40 years) COVID-19 patients to identify age-dependent imaging phenotypes and variations in disease manifestation.
